subject: High School Building Project Cost Reductions
overview: The committee selected Suffolk as the project's construction manager and approved a series of programmatic space reductions and system alternatives, bringing the total estimated cost of the high school building project to under $700 million.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes for the September 22nd meeting.

items.title: SMMA Contract Amendment
items.summary: Approved contract amendment number three for SMMA in the amount of $6,600 to hire a consultant for the future radon mitigation system design.

items.title: Construction Manager Selection
items.summary: Voted unanimously to enter contract negotiations with Suffolk, the top-ranked firm, to serve as the construction manager at risk for the project.

items.title: HVAC and Solar Recommendations
items.summary: Approved the advisory work group's recommendations to implement an air-to-water heat pump system and an optimized net-zero solar program via a Power Purchase Agreement.

items.title: Kids Corner Space Recommendations
items.summary: Approved space adjustments for the Kids Corner daycare program, resulting in an overall net increase of 350 square feet.

items.title: Medford Family Network Space Recommendations
items.summary: Approved space recommendations for the Medford Family Network, resulting in a net reduction of 500 square feet.

items.title: Central Office Space Recommendations
items.summary: Approved space adjustments for the district's central office, resulting in a net increase of 335 square feet.

items.title: Welcome Center Space Adjacencies
items.summary: Reviewed the layout of the Welcome Center and confirmed that existing spatial adjacencies will be maintained without further cuts.

items.title: Chapter 74 Space Recommendations
items.summary: Approved space efficiency recommendations for the remaining Chapter 74 vocational programs, resulting in a net reduction of 906 square feet.

items.title: Teen Health Center Space Recommendations
items.summary: Approved space recommendations for the Teen Health Center, resulting in a net reduction of 255 square feet.

items.title: High School Administration Space Recommendations
items.summary: Approved space recommendations for the high school administration suite, resulting in a net reduction of 603 square feet.

items.title: Parking and Athletic Fields Alternates
items.summary: Approved a motion to eliminate all 'field over parking' structured design options to prioritize solar canopy installations.

items.title: Untabling of April Sufficiency Proposals
items.summary: Approved a motion to untable and reduce the Steps Classroom space by 50 square feet, while leaving all other tabled proposals on the table.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Heard from community members regarding project affordability, space compromises, tax impacts, and indoor air quality systems.
